# Paraline — Desktop Audio Visualizer for Windows

> Paraline is an open-source, audio-reactive desktop edge light visualizer built for Windows 10 and Windows 11. It transforms system audio into ambient light motion along display borders.

## Overview
Paraline is a transparent desktop overlay application designed to render real-time, audio-reactive visualizers along the edges of user screens. It captures system audio playback using a high-performance native Win32 WASAPI loopback bridge, converting audio frequency amplitudes into dynamic light waves.

## Key Features
- **11 Audio-Reactive Themes:** Ambient Wave, Aurora Drift, Side Braids, Crimson Dusk, Dot Particles, Flow Border, Reactive Border, Side Bars, Edge Crystals, Ripple Flow, and Snow Bubble Particles.
- **Theme Automation:** Automated Sunrise and Sunset scheduling modes to switch visualizer presets dynamically based on daily hours or wallpaper colors.
- **Focus Mode:** Auto-dims the visualizer during active user input (mouse/keyboard activity) with smooth customizable fade transitions, restoring full brightness when idle.
- **Wallpaper Color Matching:** Extracts accent colors from the active desktop wallpaper to sync visualizer palettes automatically.
- **Audio-Reactive Color Modulation:** Dynamic hue shifting mapped to system audio beats and amplitude levels.
- **Global System Hotkeys:** Custom hotkey configuration for theme toggles, performance modes, and opacity.
- **Multi-Monitor Support:** Screen coordination across multi-display desktop setups.
- **Zero Audio Storage:** Captures real-time output PCM streams only for visual rendering. No audio is recorded, saved, or transmitted.

## System Requirements
- **OS:** Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Architecture:** x64
- **Dependencies:** .NET 8 Runtime (bundled with self-contained installer)
- **Privileges:** Standard user privileges (no administrator rights required)

## Download & Resources

## Technology Stack
- **Desktop Runtime:** Electron, Node.js
- **Audio Capturing Engine:** C# / .NET 8 Win32 WASAPI Loopback Capture
- **Graphics Engine:** HTML5 Canvas, WebGL, CSS3 Hardware Acceleration
- **Landing Website:** Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
